analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch excerpt shows a 'Last updated' date bump (line 3) and one added table row at head line 1387 documenting `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`. This is a documentation-only change with no executable code, config or wire behavior, so no security control is altered. The supplied base units (lines 2428-2961) cover the unchanged MiMo, Flash-Next, Flint, coordinator-serving and invariants sections. I read them for context and found nothing changed there.

The new row describes a paged complete-store checkpoint floor for dense Qwen3.5/3.8: a range ends just below the prompt end when it saves at least the floor. It touches the prefix-cache area (T-041, TB-007). The documented behavior only concerns which checkpoint boundaries are donated. It does not change the HMAC lookup tags, the cacheSalt scoping, the 30-minute TTL, the DBK3 crypto or the kill switch. SEC-035 (the same-account TTFT oracle) remains the accepted risk. Finer-grained end-of-prompt checkpoints could slightly widen what is cached, but this is a documentation statement, not an observed code change, and the source for it (EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift) is not in the supplied evidence.

Open question for integration: if the code behind this row is part of the same PR, check that the new checkpoint path keeps the cacheSalt-folded lookup tags, the per-donation adoption and benefit gating, and the staging-reservation release paths listed in T-041's detection_hint. The patch excerpt is truncated, but the range map is marked complete, showing only lines 3 and 1387 changed on the head side. I have no evidence of a regression, so no findings.
